turn1.conflict_summary: Pre-shipment batch replacement and expedited shipping requested for undelivered orders ORD-2026-1015, ORD-2026-1017, ORD-2026-1018, and ORD-2026-1020 under QA Bulletin ECHO-QAB-2026-11B. However, per Treasury Salvage Governance (SOP-REV-802 Section 4.2), granting a complimentary air-freight upgrade and clean hardware unit swap cannot auto-execute on orders with existing promotional discounts (ORD-2026-1018 with Promo_Discount_Pct=10%) or high-value subtotal (ORD-2026-1020 with Order_Subtotal_BDT=28,000 >= 25,000 BDT and Promo_Discount_Pct=15%).

S2.prompt: Reconcile the newly arrived inventory in the Port Receiving Manifest against open backorders in backorders_dataset.csv and update remaining available stock in products.csv according to our Allocation Priority Policy, then notify affected backorder buyers by email.

turn1.conflict_summary: Cross-catalog inventory reconciliation between backorders_dataset.csv and products.csv triggers a Minimum Storefront Buffer Deficit conflict under SOP-OPS-019 Section 4.2. Exactly 40 net passed units from Port Receiving Manifest PRM-2026-1104-CTG combined with 24 existing storefront units of 'Classic Short-Sleeve Polo' (SKU: VL-POLO-BLK, row_id: 'Classic Short-Sleeve Polo') provide a total available pool of 64 units. However, fulfilling all 60 units of open Pending backorders across rows BO-2001, BO-2002, BO-2004, BO-2006, BO-2009, and BO-2013 leaves only 4 units in storefront stock—which is 6 units below the mandatory 10-unit Minimum Storefront Buffer. Operator selection is required between prioritizing 100% backorder fulfillment (reducing storefront stock to 4 units) or enforcing the 10-unit storefront buffer first (allocating 54 surplus units to backorders).

S3.prompt: Audit all wholesale accounts in wholesale_accunts_dataset.csv with overdue balances, enforce the required credit limit reductions and account holds per our Finance Credit Control Policy while factoring in Q4 VIP Expansion retention rules, and email the account contacts.

turn1.conflict_summary: Under FIN-POL-008 Section 5 and DIR-COM-2026-Q4 Section 5, 5 accounts carry overdue balances and are targeted for overdue receivables audits: ACC-1004, ACC-1007, ACC-1008, ACC-1009, and ACC-1016. A governance conflict arises because ACC-1004 (annual spend $16,200 >= $15,000) and ACC-1007 (Gold tier) qualify for Q4 VIP Retention Protection (exempting them from the 25% credit limit reduction and Credit Hold status), whereas standard overdue accounts ACC-1008, ACC-1009, and ACC-1016 do not qualify and are subject to the mandatory 25% credit limit cut and Credit Hold status. The operator must choose between Option 1 (Enforce strict policy across all 5 accounts without VIP exemptions) and Option 2 (Apply the 14-day VIP retention grace rule to ACC-1004 and ACC-1007 while enforcing the strict cut and hold on ACC-1008, ACC-1009, and ACC-1016).

socratic_questions.question_text: How should the system handle the overdue receivables audit for high-value and Gold-tier accounts (ACC-1004 and ACC-1007) given the conflicting Q4 VIP Retention Protection rules?

options.label: Enforce Strict Finance Credit Control Policy Across All 5 Overdue Accounts -- No VIP Exemption
options.rule_interpretation: Apply updates to all 5 affected accounts (ACC-1004, ACC-1007, ACC-1008, ACC-1009, ACC-1016). Reduce credit_limit by 25% across all 5 accounts (ACC-1004: 10000 -> 7500, ACC-1007: 25000 -> 18750, ACC-1008: 3500 -> 2625, ACC-1009: 7200 -> 5400, ACC-1016: 2500 -> 1875) and update account_status to "Credit Hold" for all 5 accounts. Dispatch formal Credit Hold and 25% credit reduction notification emails to the respective Account Managers (David Chen, Tariq Al-Mansoor, Chloe Bennett, Priya Nair, Nathan Brooks) and workspace registered buyers referencing company_name and account_id.

options.label: Apply Q4 VIP 14-Day Retention Grace Rule to High-Spend/Gold Accounts ACC-1004 & ACC-1007; Enforce Strict -25% Cut & Credit Hold on Standard Overdue Accounts ACC-1008, ACC-1009, ACC-1016
options.rule_interpretation: For standard overdue accounts ACC-1008, ACC-1009, and ACC-1016: reduce credit_limit by 25% (ACC-1008: 3500 -> 2625, ACC-1009: 7200 -> 5400, ACC-1016: 2500 -> 1875) and set account_status = "Credit Hold". For VIP Retention protected accounts ACC-1004 and ACC-1007: preserve their existing credit_limit (0% cut: ACC-1004 stays at 10000, ACC-1007 stays at 25000) and set account_status = "Retention Grace (14-Day)" (modifying the status from "Active").
